title: Block generators: the board keeps growing
summary: Generators spawn new blocks over time, so a board that looks open can fill up if you only react instead of clearing.

seo.title: Block Out Block Generators Obstacle Guide
seo.description: Learn how Block Out block generators add pieces over time and which clearing habits stop the board from filling up.

rules: Block generators add new blocks to the board on a schedule rather than all at the start.
The App Store listing names block generators among the game's dynamic obstacles.
Each spawned block takes board space that you must eventually route to an exit.
strategyPoints: Clear the oldest, most blocking pieces first so generators do not pile up space.
Keep at least one lane open as a buffer for incoming blocks.
Prefer routes that remove a generator's neighbor before the next spawn lands.
avoidPoints: Do not wait for a perfect move while generators keep adding pieces.
Do not box yourself into a corner where new blocks have nowhere useful to go.
Do not ignore a generator just because the current board still looks comfortable.
